moduleDocs:
# Sortedness

The specification that every sorting and searching algorithm in the library is proved against.
A list is sorted when each element is at most every later element. The definition is stated for
any type with `≤`; the algorithms additionally ask for a `TotalPreorder`, the two order facts
their proofs use.

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.TotalPreorder
declarations.doc: The order facts that sorting needs: any two elements are comparable, and `≤` is transitive.
declarations.source:
/-- The order facts that sorting needs: any two elements are comparable, and `≤` is transitive. -/
class TotalPreorder (α : Type u) [LE α] : Prop where
  le_total : ∀ a b : α, a ≤ b ∨ b ≤ a
  le_trans : ∀ a b c : α, a ≤ b → b ≤ c → a ≤ c

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.Sorted
declarations.type: {α : Type u} → [LE α] → List α → Prop
declarations.doc: A list is sorted when each element is at most every later element.
declarations.source:
/-- A list is sorted when each element is at most every later element. -/
def Sorted (l : List α) : Prop := l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.SortedArray
declarations.type: {α : Type u} → [LE α] → Array α → Prop
declarations.doc: An array is sorted when its list of elements is.
declarations.source:
/-- An array is sorted when its list of elements is. -/
def SortedArray (a : Array α) : Prop := Sorted a.toList

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.instDecidableSortedOfDecidableLE
declarations.type: {α : Type u} → [inst : LE α] → [DecidableLE α] → (l : List α) → Decidable (Maithic.Algo.Sorted l)
declarations.source:
instance [DecidableLE α] (l : List α) : Decidable (Sorted l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)))

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.instDecidableSortedArrayOfDecidableLE
declarations.type:
{α : Type u} →
  [inst : LE α] → [DecidableLE α] → (a : Array α) → Decidable (Maithic.Algo.SortedArray a)
declarations.source:
instance [DecidableLE α] (a : Array α) : Decidable (SortedArray a) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (Sorted a.toList))

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_nil
declarations.source: @[simp] theorem sorted_nil : Sorted ([] : List α) := List.Pairwise.nil

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_singleton
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] (a : α), Maithic.Algo.Sorted [a]
declarations.source:
@[simp] theorem sorted_singleton (a : α) : Sorted [a] := by
  simp [Sorted]

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_cons
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] {a : α} {l : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted (a :: l) ↔ (∀ (b : α), b ∈ l → a ≤ b) ∧ Maithic.Algo.Sorted l
declarations.doc:
A list with a new head is sorted exactly when the head is at most every element and the tail
is sorted.
declarations.source:
/-- A list with a new head is sorted exactly when the head is at most every element and the tail
is sorted. -/
theorem sorted_cons {a : α} {l : List α} : Sorted (a :: l) ↔ (∀ b ∈ l, a ≤ b) ∧ Sorted l :=
  List.pairwise_cons

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.Sorted.tail
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] {a : α} {l : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted (a :: l) → Maithic.Algo.Sorted l
declarations.doc: The tail of a sorted list is sorted.
declarations.source:
/-- The tail of a sorted list is sorted. -/
theorem Sorted.tail {a : α} {l : List α} (h : Sorted (a :: l)) : Sorted l :=
  (sorted_cons.mp h).2

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.Sorted.head_le
declarations.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] {a b : α} {l : List α}, Maithic.Algo.Sorted (a :: l) → b ∈ l → a ≤ b
declarations.doc: The head of a sorted list is at most every later element.
declarations.source:
/-- The head of a sorted list is at most every later element. -/
theorem Sorted.head_le {a b : α} {l : List α} (h : Sorted (a :: l)) (hb : b ∈ l) : a ≤ b :=
  (sorted_cons.mp h).1 b hb

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.Sorted.sublist
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] {l₁ l₂ : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted l₂ → l₁.Sublist l₂ → Maithic.Algo.Sorted l₁
declarations.doc: Any sublist of a sorted list is sorted.
declarations.source:
/-- Any sublist of a sorted list is sorted. -/
theorem Sorted.sublist {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : Sorted l₂) (hs : l₁.Sublist l₂) : Sorted l₁ :=
  List.Pairwise.sublist hs h

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_append
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] {l₁ l₂ : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted (l₁ ++ l₂) ↔
    Maithic.Algo.Sorted l₁ ∧ Maithic.Algo.Sorted l₂ ∧ ∀ (a : α), a ∈ l₁ → ∀ (b : α), b ∈ l₂ → a ≤ b
declarations.doc:
Two sorted lists concatenate to a sorted list when everything in the first is at most
everything in the second.
declarations.source:
/-- Two sorted lists concatenate to a sorted list when everything in the first is at most
everything in the second. -/
theorem sorted_append {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    Sorted (l₁ ++ l₂) ↔ Sorted l₁ ∧ Sorted l₂ ∧ ∀ a ∈ l₁, ∀ b ∈ l₂, a ≤ b :=
  List.pairwise_append
